english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_1: You bite into the cookie. It's chocolate flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_2: Pero says the secret to happiness and joy is being at peace with yourself.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_3: Today's lucky charm: Bamboo Shoot. A day to grow and thrive. May your knowledge deepen and your dreams reach ever higher.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_4: You bite into the cookie. It's cinnamon flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_5: Pero says not to worry about the cracks in life, because that's where the light gets in.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_6: Today's lucky charm: Osmanthus. A day for diligent study. May every lesson bring you closer to the top, until the honors are yours to claim.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_7: You bite into the cookie. It's caramel flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_8: Pero says that as long as you keep moving forward with hope, nothing can stand in your way.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_9: Today's lucky charm: Persimmon. A day to look ahead. May things go your way, and may every hope in your heart find its answer.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_10: You bite into the cookie. It's black pepper and spicy soy sauce flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_11: Pero says that with confidence, courage, and perseverance, there's nothing in the world you can't do.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_12: Today's lucky charm: Wind Chime. A day to share the good things. May its gentle chime bring good news, and the breeze carry your worries away.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_13: You bite into the cookie. It's egg custard ice cream flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_14: Pero says the trick to learning lots of things is not trying to learn them all at once.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_15: Today's lucky charm: Pearl. A day to take things slow. May time polish you into something beautiful, leaving you warm and radiant through it all.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_16: You bite into the cookie. It's vanilla flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_17: Pero says the stage is full of possibilities. Just daring to step into the spotlight is a victory in itself.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_18: Today's lucky charm: Key. A day to try something new. May you find the key to new opportunities and discover a world beyond your own.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_19: You bite into the cookie. It's pickled ginger flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_20: Pero says you don't have to get everything right on the first try. Life isn't a test with only right and wrong answers. Leave a little room for the unexpected.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_21: Today's lucky charm: Jigsaw Puzzle. A day to explore. May today's unsolved puzzles fall into place in time, and may all your scattered good luck find its way to you.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_22: You bite into the cookie. It's honey pancake flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_23: Pero says you don't have to stand out to deserve applause. Anyone who lives wholeheartedly deserves a cheer.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_24: Today's lucky charm: Lily of the Valley. A day to wait and see. May good fortune find you quietly, bringing a happiness that's gentle and true.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_25: You bite into the cookie. It's pink salt and seaweed flavor.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_26: Pero says... Pero says... Pero, Pero, Pero! Pero is very happy, and so is Roccia.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_27: Today's lucky charm: Mirror. A day to appreciate yourself. May you see the light in your own reflection and discover a better you with each passing day.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_28: You bite into the cookie. It's a medley of ice cream flavors.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_29: Pero says... ahem, actually, Pero hasn't said anything all this time. These are all things I've been wanting to tell you.
english.SolarSchoolLetter_binggan_30: Today's lucky charm: Seashell. A day for new encounters. May you find a treasure all your own, even on the most ordinary of days.
